description: Sign up for a 30-day Free Trial and get access to this and 20+ ZoomCharts visuals.Drill Down Timeline PRO (Filter) helps Power BI creators build reports where time is central to the analysis. Use your date fields, calendar tables, time-based hierarchies, and DAX calculated measures to create interactive timeline visuals that let users move naturally from the full trend to the exact period they need to investigate. Instead of relying on static charts or slicers alone, report viewers can zoom into dense time-based data, pan left and right across periods, and click directly on the chart to drill down into years, quarters, months, days, hours, or other configured time levels. This makes it easier to understand what changed, when it changed, and what happened before or after the selected period. Combine up to 25 data series, choose between line, column, and area charts, and customize the time axis, colors, fonts, tooltips, navigation, and interactions to match your report design. Use it for executive trend reporting, financial analysis, operational monitoring, sales performance, IT metrics, logistics, manufacturing, and any Power BI report where users need to explore data over time with speed and context.
